SELECT status, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) d, min(order_ts_utc) mn, max(order_ts_utc) mx,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)='2025-12-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) utc_day,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', order_ts_utc)) AS DATE)='2025-12-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) local_day
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE order_ts_utc >= '2025-11-30' AND order_ts_utc < '2025-12-03'
GROUP BY status
SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) d, min(order_ts_utc), max(order_ts_utc) FROM fact_web_order

WITH o AS (
 SELECT web_order_id, status, order_ts_utc, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', order_ts_utc)) AS DATE) ld
 FROM fact_web_order)
SELECT o.ld, count(*) orders, count(s.receipt_id) matched_orders, count(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) FILTER (WHERE s.receipt_id IS NULL) unmatched
FROM o LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB') s ON s.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
WHERE o.ld BETWEEN '2025-11-24' AND '2025-12-04'
GROUP BY o.ld ORDER BY o.ld

SELECT hour(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', order_ts_utc))) h, count(*) n
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', order_ts_utc)) AS DATE)='2025-12-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT channel_code, channel_id, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) r, min(receipt_id), max(receipt_id), min(sale_date), max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2
SELECT min(web_order_id), max(web_order_id), count(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc >= '2025-11-30' AND order_ts_utc < '2025-12-03'
